venue: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium, Gainesville FL
title: Week 1 vs FAU
dek: Baugh ran it like he built the thing. Everyone else played off that.
watchNote: PROVISIONAL — scout rewrite for Charles. Fan rail stays empty.
headline: Baugh ran this offense. He hit downhill, he bounced when it died, and he left when they sat. Philo got the ball out. The skill guys blocked. That is Florida on this tape.

offense.body:
Baugh is the problem on this tape. He does not wait on a crease. If it is there he is through it. If it dies he is already outside. If the safety comes down he is gone. That is scheme feel and a different gear in the same player. One hundred sixty yards, and it never looks like they are asking him to invent a run. The line is moving people. Harris is the left guard in that group. Lovett, Moore, Shanahan, Ugorji are with him. You can see the give stay legal past first contact. You can see the bounce still be there when the first hole closes.

They mixed how they ran it. Some of it is downhill. Some of it is stretch and bounce. Almost none of it is a seven-step drop with Baugh as a checkdown. Philo is in the gun and he is operating. He sees it, he throws it, he gets to the next one. Wilson, Stockton, Harpring, Clark out of the backfield — the ball is out on time to whoever the look gives him. The one time he holds it, Sweeney is sitting and the half ends with the ball in the other color.

Brown is the one who finishes after the catch. The long one is not a bomb they hunted. It is a throw on time and a miss at the first level and then he is a problem in space. He does it again later with more air. That is who he is on this tape. Explosive. After the catch.

Clark runs. That needs to be said without turning him into a cameo. When Baugh is off, Clark is downhill, through the first man, and he has a long one of his own. The touchdown where he releases is just the same run look with the linebackers stuck on the give. He is a runner who can do that. He is not a change-of-pace they hid.

The wideouts and tight ends are in the run game. They are not standing around. You see it on Baugh’s bounce, on Stockton finishing, on the edges staying on people long enough for the back to get north. Abrams’ long ball is what happens when they finally load up to stop that run. Faulkner does not live there. He takes it when they come down.

They survive their own mess because the back is still the play. A snapped-away loss inside the five, and Baugh gets them back to the doorstep, and Philo walks it in. That is not a gadget night. That is a team that kept handing it to the right guy.
bullets: Baugh is the offense — downhill, bounce, gone when they sit.
Philo operates. The Sweeney ball is the one he holds.
Brown finishes after the catch. Clark runs.
They mix gap and stretch. They do not live in a dropback.

defense.body:
This defense comes downhill. Four-man rush. Extra body on the slot. Corners with depth. They are not sitting and reading. Graham and Chiles are in the rush and in the run. The front is turning bodies. James shows up — loss on the back, sack, hurry, the tackle that ends a half. Lyons shows up — loss on the catch, a sack with Graham. That is the line on this tape, not a two-deep mention.

They will give you yards in the zone. Short. Outside. Convert. That is the deal if the corners are going to stay over the top. What they do with the next one is go get the ball. Coleman is in the window when Veltkamp holds it. Johnson goes up and gets the other one. Coleman is on that breakup too. They attack it in the air. They pursue. When they tackle, the play dies.

The points they gave are jobs, not surprises. They packed the goal line and lost the pile. They rushed four and lost the quarterback when the end left. They sat off and lost the fade when Valsin stacked Flowers and won the back line. Same defense. Three jobs they did not finish.

Bett finishes the last one. Veltkamp keeps it, Bett gets there, the ball is out, Myles Johnson is on it. That is the rush winning the one-on-one they had been playing for.

Campbell will throw the short one and run the quarterback. Tackle the first. Keep the end at home on the second.
bullets: They come downhill. James and Lyons are on the tape.
Yards in the zone. They take the one he holds.
The points are the pile, the keep, and the fade.
Campbell: short throw and the quarterback run.

specials.body: They took the points from 53 when the drive stalled. Durkin made it. Florida never punted. They did not give the ball back on fourth down.
bullets: Durkin from 53. They took the points.
